column1: # MI2 (korean.trs), L preset: 1 bpp, every charset in one pixel face at its 16 px design size,
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# The cell is the charset's korean<NN>.fnt header doubled (bake-scumm-fonts.sh).
# Size rule (m5_sheets.py, pixel rows): 16 for every cell; a cell taller than 16 puts the
# face in the middle: ascent = 12 + (cell height - 16) / 2.
# Charsets 3, 5 and 8 have the same 16x16 cell as charset 1 (one file, M2L1.SVF, in the map).
# Charset 6 (the verb line, 22x24) has no korean06.fnt in the game, so it cannot be a row here;
# the map points it at M2L0.SVF, the 22x24 charset 0 file.
# The TTF field starts with $FONTS (default ~/scummvm-i18n/fonts; set FONTS=... to move it).
